headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: EBITDA increased 37.3% YoY and 8.6% QoQ to INR 151 Cr, with EBITDA margin at 28.0% vs 30.0% in Q1FY27, impacted by a change in business mix.
PAT stood at INR 79 Cr, up 79.5% YoY but declining 21.5% QoQ, with PAT margin at 14.7%.
The company delivered its highest-ever quarterly revenue and EBITDA, reflecting strong performance across its API, formulations and biologics businesses.
The API business recorded revenue of INR 298 Cr including captive sales, while non-captive API revenue stood at INR 255 Cr, growing 24% YoY.
valuation: The company continues to strengthen its API pipeline with 25+ non-captive CDMO client programmes and 15+ new oncology generic products targeted for completion in FY27.

Valuation call – We recommend a HOLD rating on SML with a revised target price of INR 1,027 (35X FY29E P/E) with an upside potential of 8% from the CMP of 948.
watch: Growth was supported by improved uptake of key products from expanded capacities and increasing traction in Specialty CDMO, which reported 36% YoY growth.

The Formulations business remained a key growth driver with revenue of INR 210 Cr, contributing 39% of Q2FY27 revenue and growing over 50% YoY, led by complex finished dosage formulations across regulated markets.
